name: US Brokerage Account Statement
description: US individual brokerage account statement (Schwab, Fidelity, Vanguard, Merrill, TD, IBKR and similar). Removes only client-identifying data: account numbers in labeled, partial and masked forms, SSN / tax ID (also masked), US phone numbers, ZIP+4 in address blocks, plus names, mailing addresses and e-mails from the built-in detectors. Keeps everything needed for portfolio analysis: security names, tickers, CUSIPs, quantities, prices, market values, balances, income, fees, cost basis, gains/losses, statement dates and custodian / broker information. Amounts and license plates are switched off so figures and account numbers are never treated as either. Signatures and QR codes are not detected: draw a manual box over them.

patterns.name: Account number (labeled)
patterns.description: Account number after an Account / Acct / A/C label, with optional letter prefix and dash (e.g. 1234-5678, X12-345678, U1234567)

patterns.name: Account number (bare, dash-separated)
patterns.description: Dash-separated account formats such as 1234-5678 or 123-456789 wherever they appear; phone numbers are left to the phone pattern

patterns.name: Masked account number
patterns.description: Partially masked account or card numbers: ****1234, XXX-5678, ...4321

patterns.name: SSN / Tax ID (full or masked)
patterns.description: Social Security or taxpayer ID, including masked forms such as XXX-XX-1234

patterns.name: US phone number
patterns.description: Client phone numbers; separators required so CUSIPs and account numbers are not matched

patterns.name: State + ZIP code
patterns.description: City line of an address block, e.g. FL 33101-1234 (two-letter state followed by ZIP)
